_readme: CV data rendered by src/components/CvSection.tsx on /about (EN) and on the /ja landing page (JA). To add an entry, insert an object into the relevant array — newest first (the arrays are rendered in order, not re-sorted). Every visible string has an `en` and a `ja` variant; an empty `period` is simply not rendered.
